meta.title: Investigate caching options for from_provider()
meta.body_summary: Introduce native caching support for from_provider with BaseCache, AutoCache, DiskCache, schema-aware cache keys, TTL, and documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Large caching feature PR with heavy bot review; closed by maintainer after iteration with no explicit merge block; no performance benchmark provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4788 changed lines across 26 files, this is a large PR by absolute volume, adding a new caching module across multiple layers. The closure without merge despite active maintainer iteration is unusual and likely reflects a decision to integrate the work elsewhere or to close as investigation complete.

review_details.concern_detail: Ellipsis bot flagged code duplication between async/sync cache logic, broad exception catching, and suggested DRY refactoring; no human blocking feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching API calls reduces latency and cost by avoiding repeated LLM invocations.
review_details.rejection_signals: No explicit rejection; PR closed by author after iterative improvements and applied suggestions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large cross-module addition introducing caching; Cursor managed the initial implementation, but the PR was closed by the maintainer after extensive iteration, possibly superseded or considered not ready for merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler evidence provided; only narrative about caching benefits.

core_change_summary.description: Introduce instructor.cache module with BaseCache, AutoCache (in-process LRU), DiskCache; integrate caching into patch.py for sync/async create calls; add cache parameter to from_provider with TTL support; update documentation and add tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Extensive documentation and example additions; several prototype files were later removed.

Added AutoCache, RedisCache adapters, and integration tests.
Enhanced raw response storage and serialization.
Added test for AutoCache passthrough and cache key design docs.
Added optional cache parameter to from_provider.
Added type ignore comments and debug logging.
Refactored caching implementation with TTL support.
Maintainer merged main and refactored cache helpers.
Implemented clean cache parameter flow via **kwargs.
Applied code review suggestions (version number, line removal).
Claude bot created native caching blog post.
PR closed by maintainer without merge.
